title: Compound Interest, Speed, Distance & Time
description: Class 7 IMO — Compound interest (intro), and speed, distance and time: finding speed, distance, time and average speed using the unitary method.

topics.title: Compound Interest (Intro)
topics.concept:
In simple interest the interest is the same each year. In compound interest the interest is added to the principal, so the next year's interest is calculated on a larger amount.

On ₹1000 at 10% for 2 years: year 1 interest = ₹100 (total ₹1100), year 2 interest = ₹110 (total ₹1210). So the compound interest is ₹210.

examples.problem: Find the amount and CI on ₹1000 at 10% for 2 years.
What is the CI on ₹2000 at 10% for 1 year?

recap: Compound interest is charged on the principal and on earlier interest.
For 1 year, compound interest equals simple interest.

quiz.q: Compound interest is calculated on the principal and on the ___ ?
quiz.explanation: CI adds interest to the principal, so it is charged on earlier interest too.

quiz.q: What is the CI on ₹2000 at 10% for 1 year?

topics.title: Speed, Distance & Time
topics.concept: Speed = distance ÷ time. Rearranging gives distance = speed × time and time = distance ÷ speed. A car covering 150 km in 3 hours travels at 50 km/hr.

examples.problem: A car covers 150 km in 3 hours. Find its speed.
A car travels at 60 km/hr for 4 hours. Find the distance.

recap: distance = speed × time; time = distance ÷ speed.

quiz.q: A bus covers 120 km in 2 hours. What is its speed?
A car travels at 50 km/hr for 3 hours. How far does it go?

topics.title: Average Speed & the Unitary Method
topics.concept: Average speed = total distance ÷ total time. The unitary method finds a single unit first: if a cyclist covers 90 km in 3 hours, the speed is 30 km/hr, so in 5 hours it covers 150 km.

examples.problem: A car covers 240 km in 4 hours. What is its average speed?
How long does a 300 km journey take at 50 km/hr?

recap: Average speed = total distance ÷ total time.
Unitary method: find the per-hour rate first, then scale.

quiz.q: A car covers 240 km in 4 hours. What is its average speed?
How long does a 300 km trip take at 50 km/hr?

questions.q: Compound interest is charged on the principal and on earlier ___ ?
questions.explanation: CI is charged on the principal and on earlier interest.
Average speed = total distance ÷ total time.
